name: Folkmar
notes: Young spearman, 19. Brother taken by the Roman levy. Calls holmgang on the biggest PC. Spear +4, 1d8+2.
gm_notes: Holmgang: one PC, first blood or yield, inside a pegged cloak. PC wins = village back to Muttering + 1 success; refusing = a failure. Loses well: offers his Roman dagger hilt-first. Taught the Myling (Wulf) to throw.
objective: Fight a Roman in front of everyone.
agenda: Challenges the biggest PC to holmgang.
secret: The legionary's dagger on his belt came off a dead man he found, not one he killed.
